QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expand to `private_##member` by default, and to plain `member` only when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is defined.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining the macro sees plain member names while the default consumer sees `private_`-renamed ones, and it covers who gets each view.
